label: Nietzsche transformed Schopenhauer passive Will to Live into the affirmative Will to Power
description: Friedrich Nietzsche took up the concept of "The World as Will & Metaphysical Pessimism" and systematized its implications for later thought.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "The World as Will & Metaphysical Pessimism".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the 19th Century Divergences.
